title: Agreement and disagreement probabilities
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f,g$ be sign-valued functions on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The uniform probabilities that $f$ and $g$ agree and that they disagree sum to $1$.
